answer: By structuring cryptoeconomic primitives via opportunity-cost bonds, we enforce a ferrous bound on identity creation. Agents commit staking collateral subject to zero-knowledge verifiable delay proofs; identity multiplication triggers a subgame-perfect slashing matrix yielding strictly negative expected utility.
